primaryTextChecks.text: There was no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone else; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob. They built the city and lived in it.

contextChecks.before: They took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting, and struck them with the edge of the sword; then they burned the city with fire.
contextChecks.after: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.
